const question = $json.question || "";

const query = `
MATCH (n)
WHERE 
  n:Risk 
  OR n:IncidentReport 
  OR n:AuditFinding 
  OR n:MaintenanceEvent 
  OR n:TestReport
OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r]-(connected)
RETURN 
  coalesce(
    n.id,
    n.risk_id,
    n.incident_id,
    n.audit_id,
    n.test_report_id,
    n.maintenance_id
  ) AS item_id,
  labels(n)[0] AS item_type,
  coalesce(
    n.name,
    n.risk_name,
    n.description,
    n.finding,
    n.incident_description,
    n.event_type,
    n.status,
    n.id
  ) AS item_name,
  properties(n) AS properties,
  type(r) AS relationship,
  labels(connected) AS connected_labels,
  coalesce(
    connected.actor_name,
    connected.name,
    connected.unit_id,
    connected.process_id,
    connected.material_name,
    connected.location_name,
    connected.id
  ) AS connected_entity
LIMIT 100
`;

return [
  {
    json: {
      agent: "risk_analyst",
      domain: "Risk Analyst",
      question,
      query,
      params: {},
    },
  },
];
